# fireobject

> Firestore ORM with typed CRUD, validation, query builder, hooks, unique
> fields, timestamps, soft deletes, references, and subcollections.

Version 1.0.1. Node.js 18 or newer. Peer dependency:
`@google-cloud/firestore` (`>=7 <9`).

This file is a compact index for AI agents. Read `AGENTS.md` for repository
workflows and use the MCP server for searchable documentation.

## Documentation

- [crud](./docs/crud.md): Static CRUD, saving data, and document ids.
- [development](./docs/development.md): Project scripts, local workflow, build, CI, and releases.
- [errors](./docs/errors.md): Error hierarchy and error codes.
- [field-values](./docs/field-values.md): Using native Firestore FieldValue sentinels.
- [lifecycle](./docs/lifecycle.md): Timestamps, soft deletes, transactions, batches, and bulk writes.
- [mcp](./docs/mcp.md): Running and configuring the documentation MCP server.
- [models](./docs/models.md): Models, connectors, fields, validation, field options, and hooks.
- [queries](./docs/queries.md): Query builder, composed filters, cursors, and pagination.
- [relations](./docs/relations.md): References, eager loading, and subcollections.
- [troubleshooting](./docs/troubleshooting.md): Common errors and fixes.
- [unique-fields](./docs/unique-fields.md): Atomic unique field reservations.
- [validation-helpers](./docs/validation-helpers.md): Built-in validation helpers.

## Agent resources

- [README](./README.md): Library overview and quick start.
- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): Commands, architecture, and conventions.
- [Full documentation](./llms-full.txt): All documentation in one file.
- [MCP server](./mcp/server.mjs): Zero-dependency stdio server.
- [MCP setup](./docs/mcp.md): Client configuration and tools.
